description: Resolve a city / place name to geographic coordinates and metadata (lat, lon, population, country, timezone). Use this to turn a place name into a lat/lon you can feed to opentripmap_places_radius. Example: opentripmap_geoname({ name: "Paris", country: "FR", _apiKey: "your-key" })

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 two-letter country code to disambiguate, e.g. "FR", "US"

name: opentripmap_geoname
title: Opentripmap Geoname
